question: Can TWO functional components (R75 + U18) reach U18 8/8 AND close the western BAT_PROTECTED_P trunk, with the current-carrying BAT_SENSE path de-bulged?

invariant_casualty.detail: target bit 8 (BAT_PROTECTED_P R75.2->U11.2) is FALSE in every one of the five runs, independent of which U18 pin (7, 8 or 2) the fanout leaves open. This is the western BPP trunk, and it is the single casualty every cardinality-2 move fails to close.

complementary_u18_casualty.detail: U18 caps at 7/8. The open pin is a complementary lever, not fixed: R75-west/U18-west-of-target seals U18.7 (LTC4368_FAULT_N escape), R75/U18 shifted east seals U18.8 (BAT_PROTECTED_P Kelvin reach), U18 north (72.9) seals U18.2 (LTC_UV). No card-2 move lands all of {2,7,8} at once.

analytic_cross_check.model: place_search_002z.evaluate (courtyard Dijkstra, BAT_SENSE laid first, then 8-pin fanout, then trunk)
analytic_cross_check.result: reproduces the real failure: trunk_150=None AND trunk_120=None on ALL five applied c2 poses, matching the real router NO_LEGAL_ESCAPE at D9.1 / NO_PATH at R75.2 for BAT_PROTECTED_P.
analytic_cross_check.conclusion: the analytic prefilter is trustworthy for the western BPP trunk casualty and is used to design cardinality 3.

trunk_root_cause.finding: the western BPP trunk R75.2->D9.1 routes freely (13.12 mm) at 1.50 mm when NO fanout is laid, but is dead at EVERY width down to 0.40 mm once the 8-pin U18 fanout is laid.
trunk_root_cause.meaning: the binder is the whole U18 fanout band saturating the board-edge-bounded west margin, NOT any single divider part. The trunk wants the same north-west corridor (x 2.8->6, then east along y~72.8) that U18 and its fanout occupy.
trunk_root_cause.log_evidence: c2_e05 log lines 49/55: BAT_PROTECTED_P R75.2->(stage) NO_PATH no F corridor at 1.200 mm; D9.1->(node) NO_LEGAL_ESCAPE blocked by track(x35), U18.6(x13), board_edge.

implication: Cardinality 2 cannot reach 8/8 with the western BPP trunk closed. Proceed to cardinality 3 (R75 + U18 + one support/divider part), analytic-prefiltered on graded trunk clearance.
